{"response":{"candidates":[{"index":0,"content":{"parts":[{"thoughtSignature":"","text":"\u003ccode\u003e\nbool kissat_restarting (kissat *solver) {\n  assert (solver-\u003eunassigned);\n  if (!GET_OPTION (restart))\n    return false;\n  if (!solver-\u003elevel)\n    return false;\n  if (CONFLICTS \u003c solver-\u003elimits.restart.conflicts)\n    return false;\n  if (solver-\u003estable)\n    return kissat_reluctant_triggered (&solver-\u003ereluctant);\n\n  // Density-Aware Efficiency Modulated Restarts Implementation\n\n  // Static state to maintain history across restart intervals.\n  // Note: Since we cannot modify the solver struct, we use static variables.\n  // This assumes the solver is running in a single process/thread context.\n  static double average_efficiency = 1.0;\n  static uint64_t last_props = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_confs = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_lbd2_conflict = 0;\n  static uint64_t last_binary_count = 0;\n  static bool initialized = false;\n\n  uint64_t current_props = GET (propagations);\n  uint64_t current_confs = CONFLICTS;\n  uint64_t current_binary = GET (clauses_binary);\n\n  // Handle initialization or solver reset (if conflicts count dropped)\n  if (!initialized || current_confs \u003c last_confs) {\n    average_efficiency = 1.0;\n    last_props = current_props;\n    last_confs = current_confs;\n    last_binary_count = current_binary;\n    last_lbd2_conflict = current_confs;\n    initialized = true;\n    return false;\n  }\n\n  // Step 1: Calculate interval_efficiency\n  uint64_t delta_props = current_props -
